description: This file contains a Python script implementing a command-line utility for updating SDK components, including functions for fetching manifests, updating sstate-cache, and copying configuration and layer files, specific to a Xilinx SDK environment.

methods.name: plnx_sdk_update
methods.description: Main function to update SDK components from a specified update server, handling manifest checks, sstate-cache updates, and configuration/layer file replacements.

methods.description: Registers the 'plnx-sdk-update' command with command-line argument parsers, enabling the update functionality within a larger CLI framework.
